feature: Whiteboard Done leaves the board's picture on the node (user 2026-10-22, replaces board O40): click Done until the exported picture is decoded on the node
scale: worst case the size panel allows: 4096x4096 board (export capped at the 16MP pixel budget), 12 placed photographs from 6 distinct frames of the repository real AI shot (640x360), 24 brush paths, never finished before; time from the pointer down on Done
budgetBasis: Done is a save that encodes and writes a full-resolution PNG (the node result is a reference picture for downstream generation, so it is not downscaled); a 16MP PNG encode alone takes on the order of a second. Done and the screenshot button are disabled while it runs. 3s keeps it inside a deliberate save with visible busy state; the 100ms response default is for on-screen feedback, not for encoding a file.

baseline.machine: win32 x64 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900H x20 / 64GB

budgetDebt.note: 最坏画板 ~3.2–4.5s：Leafer 导出 16MP PNG 约 0.8s，其余 2–2.8s 在共享落盘 importWorkbenchLocalAssetFile（写 9.8MB + 派生预览）；1280×720 小画板也要 ~1.5s，固定开销在落盘这段。修在共享落盘边界，不在画板里绕；期间「完成」钮当帧显示「保存中」（doneToFeedbackMs）。
